title: Hereditary
synopsis: A funeral, a treehouse, a model maker's studio, and a family that finally finds out what grandmother actually believed.

nodes.text: A microphone, a sister in a coffin, a son who refuses to come down.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Speak” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Don't” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cold.

nodes.text: A crown is set on Peter's head by hands that are not human. The cult bows. The lights of the treehouse glow yellow against a dark hill.
You set the studio alight at the right second and the figures inside dissolve into the photographs you spent your career building.
You take Peter in the truck and you do not stop driving. The country opens. The treehouse light recedes. The dread does not leave the rearview.
